**OPNduck v0.5.0-Beta** 🦆 - the performance release!

**New**
• PyTorch streaming upscaler (NVIDIA): ~1.4-3.6x faster than the classic engine, no temp image files
• GPU video encoding (NVENC) with automatic x264 fallback
• Long videos processed in chunks - small temp disk use
• AI Audio / Subtitles keep models loaded; GPU subtitles; one-click installs
• Visual trimmer, watch folder, queue controls, live logs
• All 23 Omarchy 4.5 themes built in, Electron 45, developer tools

Beta: expect bugs. Windows installers untested on real Windows. Tauri still postponed (WebKitGTK stutters/crashes with NVIDIA + Wayland).
